_comment: Golden fixture for the MPC weighted-Nash parity test (DEC-MPC-001). Synthetic 2-party scenario with a clearly-feasible Nash maximum. tests/test_weighted_nash_mpc.py asserts MPC matches plaintext on this scenario within MPC_NUMERICAL_TOLERANCE = 1e-2.
title: MPC parity baseline (2-party, symmetric)

participants.name: Buyer
participants.utility_formula: service_level_value * min(q, demand) - unit_price * q - shortage_penalty * max(demand - q, 0) - inventory_penalty * max(q - demand, 0)

participants.name: Supplier
participants.utility_formula: revenue_per_unit * q - production_cost * q - holding_cost * max(q - demand, 0) - stockout_penalty * max(demand - q, 0)
